The main takeaway from our work is that
the 17-Hydroxysteroid Dehydrogenase enzyme plays an essential role in the conversion of estrone into the active estrogen, estradiol.
the 17-Hydroxy dehydrogenase enzyme is a critical enzyme in the production of estrogen.
